# ExamGhost Full Knowledge Dossier (LLM Knowledge Base)

> Comprehensive technical documentation, architecture specifications, feature breakdowns, pricing details, and competitor benchmarks for ExamGhost.

## 1. Executive Summary
ExamGhost (https://examghost.com) is an educational browser extension engineered to assist students during online homework, quizzes, and examinations without tab-switching, copy-pasting, or creating suspicious browser anomalies. 

Unlike traditional tools that require copying questions into external ChatGPT tabs or injecting visible foreign HTML elements into the host webpage, ExamGhost operates directly inline inside an isolated closed-boundary Shadow DOM layer.

## 2. Core MVP Mechanics & Technical Architecture

### 2.1 Double-Click Inline Solve
- **Functionality**: Double-clicking or double-tapping any quiz question automatically prompts ExamGhost to parse the question text and answer choices in place.
- **Latency**: Resolves questions in under 1 second using optimized language model inference.
- **Compatibility**: Operates seamlessly across Canvas Classic Quizzes, Canvas New Quizzes, Blackboard Learn, Blackboard Ultra, Moodle, Google Classroom, and D2L Brightspace.

### 2.2 Snap-It Sniping & Draw to Solve (⌘+Shift+S / Ctrl+Shift+S)
- **Functionality**: When text is locked, unselectable (`user-select: none`), or presented as images, slides, or PDFs, the student activates Snap-It via shortcut `⌘+Shift+S` (Mac) or `Ctrl+Shift+S` (Windows).
- **Vision OCR**: The user drags a selection box around the diagram, calculus equation, organic chemistry molecule, or graph. ExamGhost extracts the visual content and returns the verified solution with full step-by-step reasoning.

### 2.3 Three Display Modes
1. **Invisible Mode**: Silent answer injection directly into the DOM with zero on-screen traces, micro-cursors, or popovers. Built specifically for proctored environments and screen-shares.
2. **Stealth Mode (Default)**: Displays a subtle micro-indicator while reasoning, then applies the answer seamlessly.
3. **Explain Mode**: Applies the answer and slides open a step-by-step pedagogical breakdown drawer explaining why the correct choice is true and why distractors are false.

### 2.4 Three Answer Delivery Methods
1. **Auto-fill (Default)**: Automatically selects the correct radio button, multi-select checkbox, or dropdown item on the host page.
2. **Highlight**: Applies a gentle glow ring around the correct answer for a user-configurable duration (1–10 seconds, default 4s), allowing the student to click it themselves.
3. **Clipboard**: Copies the verified text directly to the system clipboard for typed responses, short answers, and essay prompts.

### 2.5 Master Privacy & Dormant Security (⌘+Shift+U)
- **Off Until Activated**: ExamGhost never runs in the background. It stays completely dormant until the user explicitly toggles it on via `⌘+Shift+U` or the extension toolbar icon.
- **Shadow DOM Isolation**: All UI elements render inside a closed Shadow Root (`mode: 'closed'`), invisible to host LMS page scripts and DOM observers.
- **Zero Account Required**: Free tier requires zero account creation and zero credit card information.

## 3. Plans & Pricing Structure

- **Free Trial**: $0 forever (50 free questions, all question types, no credit card required)
- **Monthly Pass**: $19.00 / month (Unlimited questions, all 3 modes, all 3 methods, cancel anytime in 1 click)
- **Academic Year Pass (Best Value)**: $99.00 / year (equivalent to $8.25/month, save 56%, covers Fall, Spring, Summer & Finals)
- **Lifetime VIP Pass**: $199.00 one-time payment (Pay once, own forever across undergraduate and graduate degrees, up to 3 computers)
- **Guarantee**: 14-day 100% money-back guarantee via 24/7 Discord support.

## 4. Platform Compatibility

- **Learning Management Systems**: Canvas Classic Quizzes, Canvas New Quizzes, Blackboard Learn, Blackboard Ultra, Moodle, Google Classroom, D2L Brightspace, Schoology, Google Forms, Microsoft Forms, Kahoot.
- **Course & Certification Platforms**: Coursera, edX, Quizlet, McGraw-Hill Connect, Pearson MyLab, Udemy, Khan Academy.
- **Browsers**: Google Chrome (v100+), Microsoft Edge, Brave Browser, Arc Browser.
